summary: Vox Royalty Corp. filed a 6-K reporting that its subsidiary, Vox Royalty Australia Pty Ltd., entered a binding agreement to acquire an effective 0.75% net smelter return royalty over Boab Metals Limited's construction-stage Sorby Hills silver-lead project in Western Australia for $13,000,000 cash from a private seller. Completion is subject to customary conditions and Australian Foreign Investment Review Board approval, targeted for Q4 2026. Sorby Hills is fully permitted and funded, with first concentrate production targeted H2 2027 and average annual output of about 2.2Moz silver plus 68kt lead over an initial 8.5-year mine life. Watch FIRB clearance timing and reserve-extension drilling that could lengthen mine life.
